posts.name: RituparnaBhaumik
posts.cooked:
Hello,

A follow up on this - the BPT’s completed last term are still showing up in the VM portal as the questions are same. Do we need to delete those solutions and re submit again? Also, why does the dashboard show marks for GA and GRPA’s again?

image1894×441 20.1 KB

posts.name: Varalakshmi
posts.cooked: If yes, how can I submit them again? I already have my previous submissions and I’m unable to delete them. Can someone please clarify this?

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: Yes BPT submissions is mandatory. Please run synchro eval again for each question.

posts.name: RituparnaBhaumik
posts.cooked: So I just need to ensure that I do a synchro eval to all the BPT’s submitted earlier and there is no need to delete the previous submissions and re submit again?

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: No need to delete. Please ensure the synchro eval are successful

posts.cooked: I’m repeating SC. My previous term BPTs are already there. So I just synchro evaled every questions and it passed. Is that enough?
